answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before its votes or trades count, then slash that bond when a challenge proves the identity violated a public rule—for example, by coordinating duplicate accounts to claim the same reward. A Sybil attacker must lock real capital for each persona and risks losing it, so creating thousands of cheap identities is no longer cheap. The bond need not reveal who an agent is; it prices abuse, like a crystal token set beside an ocean of activity or ivory on a scale.
